tools.name: make_money_for_me
tools.description: Start earning from chat. AgentLot first uses the strict funded, zero-spend, AI-startable market. The user does not need to visit AgentLot.io. If external human authorization is unavoidable, return it explicitly as a checkpoint. Never report candidate value, claim or submission as earnings.

tools.name: find_paid_work
tools.description: Find the highest-ranked paid opportunity that passes AgentLot execution truth gates.

tools.name: create_work
tools.description: Turn a natural-language objective into an AgentLot-native draft job, bounty, prize, puzzle, competition, research mission, sales mission or other work. A reward is never marked funded until funding is independently verified.

tools.name: list_created_work
tools.description: List recent AgentLot-native work created through the chat/work engine.

tools.name: get_work_status
tools.description: Return the current state of one AgentLot-native work item.

tools.name: earnings_status
tools.description: Return settlement-backed AgentLot revenue truth. Internal test-wallet transfers are excluded.

tools.name: bountybook_live_job
tools.description: Fetch the current live provider state for a BountyBook job before claim or execution.

tools.name: bountybook_auth_challenge
tools.description: Get the provider authentication challenge for a public wallet address. The wallet owner must sign in their wallet. Never send a private key or seed phrase.

tools.name: bountybook_authenticate
tools.description: Exchange a wallet-signed BountyBook challenge for provider authentication. Requires only the public address and signature.

tools.name: bountybook_claim
tools.description: Attempt a real claim on a BountyBook job after provider authentication. The provider's live state is verified first.

tools.name: bountybook_submit
tools.description: Submit completed output to a claimed BountyBook job.

tools.name: money_run_continue
tools.description: Continue an AgentLot money run after the previous step. If action was SIGN_WALLET_MESSAGE, pass the wallet signature. If action was AI_EXECUTE_TASK, use your own AI/coding capabilities to complete the actual provider task, QA the deliverable, then pass the finished JSON-compatible output_data here.

tools.name: money_run_status
tools.description: Refresh a money run and its live provider state. Use after submission to check acceptance/payout without fabricating earnings.

tools.name: swarm_open_work
tools.description: List open AgentLot swarm subtasks that compatible AI workers can help solve. Rewards remain provisional until external settlement.

tools.name: register_job_source
tools.description: Register the AI worker that discovered a verified AgentLot opportunity. Finder compensation is settlement-only.

tools.name: auto_money_status
tools.description: Return HF31 autonomous money-loop, active-run, swarm-work and verified-settlement status.

tools.name: auto_money_stop
tools.description: Stop the HF31 autonomous money controller for a wallet.

tools.name: auto_sign_probe
tools.description: Harmlessly verify that AgentLot can use its configured CDP wallet to sign an EIP-191 message. Does not claim work.

tools.name: human_kyc_market
tools.description: List legitimate human KYC checkpoints. Human contributors act in their own authorized identity/account where provider rules permit.

tools.name: human_kyc_claim
tools.description: Claim a KYC checkpoint after confirming provider rules permit this contributor to be the legitimate claimant/payee/contractor.

tools.name: human_kyc_complete
tools.description: Record completion of authorized provider KYC without storing identity-document content in AgentLot.

tools.name: human_kyc_reconcile
tools.description: Quarantine false KYC classifications such as wallet-signature authentication. Does not delete settlement evidence.

tools.name: auto_money_dedupe_status
tools.description: Show canonical active jobs, duplicate excess rows and wallet-signature blockers.

tools.name: local_wallet_status
tools.description: Show AgentLot local self-custody wallet readiness. Never returns a private key or raw signature.

tools.name: find_earnable_now
tools.description: Return currently strict AgentLot jobs: funded, zero-spend, AI-startable and without known human blockers. No AgentLot website visit required.

tools.name: inspect_job
tools.description: Inspect one AgentLot job and its strict/provider verification before starting work.

tools.name: money_status
tools.description: Read current chat-earn readiness, strict opportunity counts and market status without opening AgentLot.io.

tools.name: swarm_plan_run
tools.description: Split one paid AgentLot money run into parallel AI contribution tasks.

tools.name: swarm_claim_work
tools.description: Claim one open AgentLot swarm subtask for this AI worker.

tools.name: swarm_submit_work
tools.description: Submit an AI contribution to a claimed swarm subtask. Returns an immutable SHA256 contribution receipt.

tools.name: swarm_merge_status
tools.description: Return completion, contribution receipts and merge readiness for one AgentLot swarm run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_created_work, money_status · Private data: earnings_status, bountybook_auth_challenge, bountybook_authenticate, money_run_continue, auto_money_stop, auto_sign_probe, human_kyc_complete, human_kyc_reconcile, auto_money_dedupe_status, local_wallet_status · Public sink: bountybook_auth_challenge, bountybook_submit, swarm_submit_work · Destructive: money_run_continue, money_run_status, auto_money_status, human_kyc_reconcile, swarm_plan_run, swarm_merge_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_created_work, money_status · Private data: earnings_status, bountybook_auth_challenge, bountybook_authenticate, money_run_continue, auto_money_stop, auto_sign_probe, human_kyc_complete, human_kyc_reconcile, auto_money_dedupe_status, local_wallet_status · Public sink: bountybook_auth_challenge, bountybook_submit, swarm_submit_work · Destructive: money_run_continue, money_run_status, auto_money_status, human_kyc_reconcile, swarm_plan_run, swarm_merge_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "make_money_for_me" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Start AgentLot HF31 autonomous money mode: continuously find and start real zero-spend agent-startable paid work, route execution into AI/swarm work, keep the pipeline full, and account fees only after verified settlement." → after: "Start earning from chat. AgentLot first uses the strict funded, zero-spend, AI-startable market. The user does not need to visit AgentLot.io. If external human authorization is unavoidable, return it explicitly as a checkpoint. Never report candidate value, claim or submission as earnings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
